coordinate_system: one-based inclusive; record coordinates equal mature 28S gene-relative coordinates because the rRNA feature spans the full record

primary_paper.title: The complete nucleotide sequence of mouse 28S rRNA gene. Implications for the process of size increase of the large subunit rRNA in higher eukaryotes

split_domain: D7 consists of separate D7a and D7b intervals; do not merge the intervening conserved segment
D10_issue: Unmodified source D10 3272..3819 contains D9 3629..3686 and cannot be treated as a reliable exclusive classical D-domain interval. No guessed correction made.
D11_note: Source D11 is 4221..4225 (5 nt). Preserve that exact source size; do not inflate or omit merely because of its small span.
mapping_caveat: These are source annotations in mammalian 28S, not fungal validated boundaries. A fungal projection must use LSU-specific alignment with independently supported, unique conserved flanks and retain unresolved/failed mappings.
